payload.rationale: The movie 'Why Did I Get Married Again?' was ranked #1 on the US Netflix film chart for the preceding week (September 7-13). Movies that secure the top spot often carry momentum into the following week. However, as an older licensed title rather than a new Netflix Original, its viewership spike may be short-lived. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is that a new, highly anticipated movie released later in the target week (e.g., on Friday, September 18) could easily accumulate enough viewing hours over the weekend to claim the #1 spot. The strongest reason this estimate could be too low is if the current week's new release slate is exceptionally weak, allowing the movie to maintain its lead through sustained viral interest.
limitations: Lack of daily viewership data or current-week trajectory.
Unknown slate of competing new releases for the target week.
